query.en: Make an A5 portrait flyer for a free community seed swap. Two-colour riso look (deep green and coral on warm off-white paper), simple flat line-art sprouts at the top, a huge two-line headline 'Seed / Swap', one friendly sentence underneath, then a When / Where / Bring list and who's hosting. Leave `—` placeholders for the date, place and contact I haven't given you. It has to print well and still read as a phone photo.
